title: Why are there 12 signs?
old_caption:
Astrology splits the Sun's yearly path into 12 equal 30-degree slices, named for constellations along it. The real constellations vary in size.
Twelve slices, one shared sky.

title: The first cold night
old_caption: One cold night and suddenly all twelve signs are taking blanket applications. The stars have a better question than who's free all winter. Who in your group chat started cuffing first?

title: Aries asks in October energy
old_caption: Aries skipped hello and went straight to a sign that says WINTER WITH ME?, in a T-shirt, in the snow. Same fire, a little slower. Ever been asked out at full speed?

title: Taurus builds the blanket fort first
old_caption: Taurus built a five-star fort with a snack shelf and forgot to invite anyone into it. One text fixed that. Who would you send the fort invite to?

title: Gemini's three almost-dates
old_caption: Three maybes, one Friday, one very dizzy Gemini. Two kind no's and a real yes later, Friday got a lot calmer. Tag the friend who says maybe to everything.

title: Cancer has the soup ready
old_caption: Cancer made a whole pot of soup for someone it hadn't asked yet, then hid behind the counter when they walked by. Brave move at the door, though. What's your comfort meal?

title: Leo wants a winter photo partner
old_caption: Leo auditioned a snowman, a lamp post and a passing Sagittarius, and somehow every print was still just Leo. Then it turned the camera around. Who takes the best photos of you?

title: Virgo's cuffing spreadsheet
old_caption: Virgo's spreadsheet found a perfect 4/4 match and Virgo felt nothing. Then a Sagittarius tripped in with cocoa and the heart monitor went wild. Which column would you add?

title: Libra can't pick between two scarves
old_caption: Libra spent half an hour on two scarves, then polled the group chat about two people and got a tie. Turns out it kept reaching for the same one all along. Are you a group-chat poller?

title: Scorpio, all in or nothing
old_caption: Gemini said cocoa. Scorpio heard matching mittens, a shared calendar and a cabin. Deep is a gift, and it can still start with one sip. Who in your life goes all in?
